2026-11-20FINCanadian International Trade Tribunal ActOrder Referring the Matter of the Importation of Certain Vegetable Goods to the Canadian International Trade TribunalOrder Referring to the Canadian International Trade Tribunal (CITT), for Inquiry into and Reporting on, the Matter of the Exclusion of Certain Canned Vegetable Goods from the Certain Canned Vegetable Goods Surtax Order in order to direct the CITT to conduct an inquiry to determine whether certain products should be excluded from the final safeguard measure on certain canned vegetable imports.N/A
subject: Order Referring the Matter of the Importation of Certain Vegetable Goods to the Canadian International Trade Tribunal
precis: Order Referring to the Canadian International Trade Tribunal (CITT), for Inquiry into and Reporting on, the Matter of the Exclusion of Certain Canned Vegetable Goods from the Certain Canned Vegetable Goods Surtax Order in order to direct the CITT to conduct an inquiry to determine whether certain products should be excluded from the final safeguard measure on certain canned vegetable imports.
